post.summary: Pair the person's phone with the family's code
post.description: No other credential is needed: the code is the proof. The answer carries a long random device token, shown once; keep it on the phone and send it as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Only its hash is stored. A wrong, used or expired code all give the same 400, so a guess learns nothing. Limited to 10 tries a minute per address.

400.description: The code is wrong, used or expired (code `invalid_code`), or the body is invalid

429.description: More than 10 tries a minute from this address

post.summary: Record that a dose was taken
post.description: Idempotent: one record per slot. The first call answers 201 and tells the family live; a retry answers 200 with the same record and changes nothing. The medicine must be on the phone's plan and the slot must belong to it.

400.description: The medicine is not on this phone's plan (`unknown_medicine`), the slot does not belong to the medicine (`invalid_slot`), or the body is invalid

post.summary: Raise an alert for the family
post.description: Kinds: `missed_dose`, `double_dose`, `emergency`. `missed_dose` and `emergency` are created only if the family consented; the answer says why not (`created: false`, `reason: no_consent`). A missed or repeated-dose alert is unique per slot (`reason: duplicate` on a retry); every emergency is recorded. Answers 201 when created, 200 otherwise.

get.summary: Live events for the family: a server-sent-events stream
get.description: Each frame is `data: {json}` followed by a blank line. Types: `dose`, `alert`, `plan`, `device`, `voice`, `ping` (every 15 seconds). The server sends a `ping` the moment the stream opens. The stream closes at the next check if the session or the membership ends. Some proxies hold streams back (a Cloudflare quick tunnel does): then use the poll endpoint, or the client in `@kaabil/contract`, which switches by itself.

get.summary: The same events by long polling
get.description: Ask what happened after event id `after`; the answer waits up to `wait` milliseconds for news. Without `after` the answer has no events and `last` is where to start. Keep the newest `last` and send it as `after` next time. The server keeps the last 100 events per group.

parameters.description: Milliseconds to wait for news, 0 to 10000. Default 0

put.summary: Save your recording of one sentence
put.description: The body is the audio itself. Needs the header `x-voice-consent: yes`: the person recording agrees it is stored and played to the person. Accepted types: `audio/wav`, `audio/x-wav`, `audio/webm`, `audio/ogg`, `audio/mp4`, `audio/mpeg`, and the first bytes must match the type. 200 bytes to 1.5 MB. Only a sentence in the list above can be recorded. Replaces an earlier recording. In the browser, process it first (`processRecording` in `@kaabil/voice`: trim, even out, mono 16 kHz WAV).

post.summary: Send a call message to the person's phone
post.description: Voice and video calls go directly between the two phones (WebRTC); this server only carries the setup messages. The body is one signal: `ring`, `accept`, `decline`, `offer`, `answer`, `ice` or `hangup`, with a `callId` (8 to 64 letters, digits or dashes, the same for the whole call) and `from` (it must match who is sending). The other side receives it as a live `call` event. Limits: 300 messages a minute and 6 `ring`s in 5 minutes for each care group.

parameters.description: The care group id: from POST /api/care/groups or GET /api/care/me

get.summary: Which servers to use to connect a call (family)
get.description: Pass the answer as `iceServers` to `RTCPeerConnection`. Always a public STUN server. When a Cloudflare Realtime TURN key is configured (`CF_TURN_KEY_ID`, `CF_TURN_API_TOKEN`), short-lived relay credentials are added so a call still connects when a network blocks the direct path. If the relay cannot be reached the answer is STUN only. Never cached.
